text:
jo (growth): Quick idea 15min office-hours launch next Thurs. Offer = "credit boost" + 1-click prompt pack install. Goal: short path to first-success and a benchmark narrative for launch posts. Thoughts?
kai (product): Love shorter timebox. Demo must be the exact 3-step flow we want users to replicate. Keep it mobile-friendly.
ash (content): I'll author 2 prompt packs: 'Quick PR draft' and 'Problem->Solution one-pager'. We should test hero prompt wording.
rachel (ops): Infra notes: implement auto-apply credits when ?seed=oh_boost, coupon TTL 7d. Will need coupon code and server cap per account.
omar (analytics): Metrics: activation% (first API call that passes quality flag), time-to-first-success, tokens used in 7d, cost-per-activated. Add experiment_id and variant tags.
jo (growth): Variants: light = 4 credits + PR pack; heavy = 12 credits + one-pager + onboarding email. Gate heavy to office-hours RSVPs only to control spend.
kai (product): Gate seems right. Also add a 15% holdout (no credits) to measure the organic baseline.
rachel (ops): Server-side: ```py
if params.get('seed') == 'oh_boost' and user.is_new():
  apply_credits(user, amount)
```
I'll set amount per variant and per-user cap.
omar (analytics): Events: credit_assigned, prompt_pack_selected, first_success_flag. Will instrument dashboard with cohort and cost curves.
ash (content): Draft social copy: teaser + live gif + TL;DR results post. Also capture 1-sentence outcome via in-app micro-survey: "Did you ship something helpful in 3 tries?"
jo (growth): Timeline: @ash drafts by Tue EOD, @rachel coupons + routing Tue AM, @omar dashboard Wed AM, @kai confirm demo flow. We'll review Wed 4pm. :rocket:
ci-bot: calendar event created: "Office-Hours: Credit Boost Launch" Thu 14:00-14:15
ash (content): Also propose a tiny follow-up email with top 3 winning prompts and invite to install prompt pack.
omar (analytics): We'll track uplift and estimated incremental cost per activated user. If heavy variant cost per activated > 3x light, we'll pause.
jo (growth): Great. Action items noted. Reconvene Wed 4pm. :thumbsup:
